callouts.text: 1 · Select Code. Use its floating ribbon to change language, −/+ type size, or # Lines.
2 · Open ↔ 48ch. Choose Compact/Standard/Wide/Extra wide, or type 72 in Custom.
3 · Click the selected code body to enter CodeMirror. Type a line, then freely drag the lower-right handle and watch ch.
PASS WHEN · One Code block changes language, font size, numbered lines, and preset/custom width; edits in CodeMirror; and reports ch during a native resize.
